text: Once again I get a question about a girlfriend cheating on the guy and now him wanting to get back together with her. My girlfriend had opened up to me about cheating on me in our past relationship. We had broke up previously because we both wanted to focus on each other and the spark wasn't there. But now we decided to get back together and she opened up about her cheating on me during our last relationship. I am not sure how I feel about this and if I should even trust her. You guys are gonna push me over the edge with your questions. You are not sure how you feel about it? She told you that she cheated on you. She spat in your face. She betrayed you. She basically told you, you are not a man enough for me. I would rather go and sleep with another dude and you are not sure how you feel about it? And should you trust her? She had went to her ex house and things happened. Should I be glad she told me? Should you be glad she told you? Of course man, now that she told you about this it's all gone. It's all in the past. From now on you can have a great and happy life. No man, the fact that she told you makes it even worse because she is not only a traitor but she also is not very smart traitor. Because if she would be smart she would realize that such information causes pain and if she wants to have higher chances with you, she should be silent about it. But it seems like with you it doesn't even matter. She could tell you that she had a train with 10 guys and you would still be okay with it. Or should I now set new boundaries and be stricter? I am stuck and need your opinion on this. Set new boundaries? For the boundaries to be new, they should exist in the first place. You have no boundaries man. No, you do not get back together with your ex. No, you do not forgive cheating. Once again, your whole understanding of dating, principles, self-respect is a big mess. Hopefully you have at least some success in some other areas of your life. You do not need any relationships right now. You need to start working on yourself and there's a lot of work ahead of you. Once again guys, you can DM me your relationship slash dating questions and if you want a direct response from me, you can become a paid subscriber. This way you can also support my channel. Thanks a lot and bye!
